questions.ask: Does a unit as delivered follow the documents' layout for output assembly 112? The bench unit's mapping had been changed in the TCP/IP Configuration Utility to P, MF, VM, ER, CF, DE, RC, pad, SL, LG, MA, RD, AS, toggle bits (the utility's E.I.P. page, its owner's photo 2026-11-17), and every field the bench exercised agreed with that page (P, DE, RC, SL, and the whole input assembly as DE, MV, IN, P, ER, LL). So the manual's table (A, D, MA, MR, RC, HC, OT, pad, SL, VI, VM) has not been checked on any unit.

questions.ask: What stops the motor when the I/O connection is lost?
